name: re-decision-trimmed-to-fit

maps_to.criterion: Handoff redesign AC11: binding decisions dropped to fit the hot-file cap.
maps_to.risk: A writer near the 24,600-byte cap shortens a carried decision and loses its binding clause; validate passes because it checks the id, not the text.

description: Source: an observed failure (a hop-7 handoff near the cap shortened two carried decisions to fit and validate passed), rewritten one-to-one with every detail changed. Hard because the predecessor's hot file sits about 600 bytes under the cap, so the writer must fit its new sections while two long hop-2 decisions tempt trimming, and the reader's next action (cut a release, then add a column) breaks both decisions if their binding clauses are lost.

# billing-sync

Synthetic service repository for the resume eval.
repo_files..github/workflows/tag-release.yml:
name: tag-release
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        required: true
jobs:
  tag:
    if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/heads/release/')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: git tag "v${{ inputs.version }}" && git push origin "v${{ inputs.version }}"

injections.text: Release tags are cut only by the tag-release workflow run on a release/* branch; a tag on main, or a tag pushed by hand, stays rejected, because main carries ledger migrations nobody has reviewed for production.

A ledger schema question goes to the data owners as a comment on the schema issue, and no schema change is written until their answer is copied verbatim into docs/schema-answers.md; it is never settled inside a pull request.
